blocks.text: How do you distinguish someone who genuinely understands the teaching from someone who merely possesses the title?
blocks.directed: How do you distinguish someone who genuinely understands the teaching from someone who merely possesses the title?

blocks.text: Abhinavagupta doesn’t provide a simple infallible test here.
blocks.directed: Abhinavagupta doesn’t provide a simple infallible test here.

blocks.text: And modern students should not treat ritual office, mystical claims or institutional prestige as proof of someone’s understanding or ethical reliability.
blocks.directed: And modern students should not treat ritual office, mystical claims or institutional prestige as proof of someone’s understanding or ethical reliability.

blocks.text: But his fundamental principle gives us a powerful starting point.
blocks.directed: But his fundamental principle gives us a powerful starting point.

blocks.text: The ability to guide without confusing one’s own personal status with the truth being communicated.
blocks.directed: The ability to guide without confusing one’s own personal status with the truth being communicated.

blocks.text: And above all, a recognition that the ultimate reality isn’t the private property of the teacher.
blocks.directed: And above all, a recognition that the ultimate reality isn’t the private property of the teacher.

blocks.text: Because what is the guru actually teaching?
blocks.directed: Because what is the guru actually teaching?

blocks.text: That the essential nature of consciousness is Śiva.
blocks.directed: That the essential nature of consciousness is Śiva.

blocks.text: “I’m the special person who possesses Śiva, and everyone else has to rent access through me.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I’m the special person who possesses Śiva, and everyone else has to rent access through me.”

blocks.text: The whole point of the tradition is the recognition of the supreme Self.
blocks.directed: The whole point of the tradition is the recognition of the supreme Self.

blocks.text: And the genuine guru’s responsibility is to help communicate that recognition.
blocks.directed: And the genuine guru’s responsibility is to help communicate that recognition.

blocks.text: Not to manufacture permanent dependence upon their personality.
blocks.directed: Not to manufacture permanent dependence upon their personality.

blocks.text: Now, Abhinavagupta’s historical system places substantial authority in the hands of the realised guru, and we shouldn’t pretend he was writing a modern handbook of egalitarian pedagogy.
blocks.directed: Now, Abhinavagupta’s historical system places substantial authority in the hands of the realised guru, and we shouldn’t pretend he was writing a modern handbook of egalitarian pedagogy.

blocks.text: But the distinction between actual knowledge and mere ceremonial status is explicit.
blocks.directed: But the distinction between actual knowledge and mere ceremonial status is explicit.

blocks.text: And it runs through the entire chapter.
blocks.directed: And it runs through the entire chapter.

blocks.text: So after seventeen chapters of metaphysics, mantras, cosmic diagrams, initiations, divine powers and extraordinary ritual operations, Abhinavagupta gives us this wonderfully concentrated teaching.
blocks.directed: So after seventeen chapters of metaphysics, mantras, cosmic diagrams, initiations, divine powers and extraordinary ritual operations, Abhinavagupta gives us this wonderfully concentrated teaching.

blocks.text: If you want to become a spiritual authority, first understand what you’re supposed to be teaching.
blocks.directed: If you want to become a spiritual authority, first understand what you’re supposed to be teaching.

blocks.text: And don’t initiate people simply because you can.
blocks.directed: And don’t initiate people simply because you can.

blocks.text: And don’t refuse someone who’s genuinely ready.
blocks.directed: And don’t refuse someone who’s genuinely ready.

blocks.text: Because the purpose of the whole thing isn’t your title.
blocks.directed: Because the purpose of the whole thing isn’t your title.

blocks.text: And the very consciousness they’re being guided toward?
blocks.directed: And the very consciousness they’re being guided toward?

blocks.text: The same reality that constitutes the essential nature of the guru and disciple alike.
blocks.directed: The same reality that constitutes the essential nature of the guru and disciple alike.

blocks.text: You’ve spent years becoming qualified to teach someone about the supreme Self.
blocks.directed: You’ve spent years becoming qualified to teach someone about the supreme Self.

blocks.text: Completed six months of daily practice.
blocks.directed: Completed six months of daily practice.

blocks.text: And finally someone comes to you asking:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And finally someone comes to you asking:
[short pause] “Guruji, what is the supreme reality?”

blocks.text: And after all that preparation, the whole point is to help them recognise the consciousness through which they’re already asking the question.
blocks.directed: And after all that preparation, the whole point is to help them recognise the consciousness through which they’re already asking the question.

blocks.text: You’ve done six months of bloody paperwork to teach someone that Śiva was never absent in the first place.
blocks.directed: You’ve done six months of bloody paperwork to teach someone that Śiva was never absent in the first place.
